events.title: CH13: Rest Stop Releases on October 28!
events.summary: CH13: Rest Stop has an official release date - October 28, 2026 :) I’ve also uploaded a New Official Trailer, along with an Updated Demo! It’s a more polished version of what was there before - I wanted it to better reflect how the full game will look. This is the final version before release. So if you haven’t played the demo yet, now is a great time to check it out :) If you’ve already played it before, I’d probably recommend waiting for the full game. events.title: Thank you for all the support!
events.summary: I just wanted to say thank you :) I got a lot of feedback from you in reviews, steam discussion and in private messages on Instagram and X/Twitter. I still can’t believe how positive the response has been!Thank you all for your support! I’m truly grateful :)I’m so glad that you're enjoying something I've worked on for so long.I’ll give it my all to make the full game the best it can be!

events.title: CH13: Rest Stop Demo is OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hey everyone! It took me a year, but I finally released a demo for CH13: Rest Stop! 📢It's around 15-20 minutes long and it gives you first look at the atmosphere and horror experience I’m building for the full game. I’d be really happy if you decided to give it a try, and I’d love to hear what you think! You can leave a review on Steam or message me on X/Twitter: @Yell0wSmile If you enjoy it, please consider wishlisting the full game! Full game will probably be ready at the end of the 2026.Thank

events.title: Development update
events.summary: Hello everyone! 👋When I first created this store page, my initial plan was to release Rest Stop for free. After giving it more thought, I’ve decided to set a small price instead. This will help me cover some development costs and support future projects.The game is still in early development. I’m pouring all my energy into it and hope it’ll be an experience you’ll enjoy.Thank you for your understanding and for supporting my work! 💙
